primary_access.title: Characterization of a novel type of serine/threonine kinase that specifically phosphorylates the human goodpasture antigen.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete original abstract read: recombinant 624-aa GPBP binds the N-terminal human Goodpasture-antigen region. Current official Q9Y5P4 identity is CERT1 and cautions that the original kinase assignment changed; this does not negate physical binding. No exact original target pair was found in the queried IntAct/MINT export. Publisher recovery yielded metadata or challenge HTML, not full original Methods.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Positive recombinant624-aa GPBP binding to human Goodpasture antigen; kinase attribution must be distinguished from physical interaction.

primary_access.title: Distinct antitumor properties of a type IV collagen domain derived from basement membrane.

reference_review.review_notes: Original indexed full Methods, Results, Discussion and captions recovered at https://www.researchgate.net/publication/12549337 . They verify apoptosis assays; MMP inhibition is a Discussion hypothesis. This is external article text, not a rewritten abstract cache or a PDF-pixel read. Canonical article DOI: https://doi.org/10.1074/jbc.M001956200 ; the independently recovered author-copy Discussion supplies the MMP hypothesis, which cannot be inferred from its absence in the abstract.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Human NC1 fragment antiangiogenic and exposed C-terminal antitumor segments; abstract alone does not resolve inhibitor8191.

actual_read_entries.scope: Follow-up original indexed Methods530–1074, Results1076–1712, Discussion1714–2144 and captions; external text, not cached full text.

primary_access.title: Two RGD-independent alpha vbeta 3 integrin binding sites on tumstatin regulate distinct anti-tumor properties.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete original abstract read: two RGD-independent alphaVbeta3-binding sites in tumstatin have separable endothelial versus melanoma effects. Full Methods were not recovered. Neither a cryptic truncation-dependent C-terminal effect nor fragment-relative numbering is automatically the activity/coordinate of every current full-length splice product.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Two separable RGD-independent integrin binding fragments and cell-specific proliferation effects.

primary_access.title: Human tumstatin and human endostatin exhibit distinct antiangiogenic activities mediated by alpha v beta 3 and alpha 5 beta 1 integrins.

reference_review.review_notes: DISPUTED at figure-specific scope. The official 2019 notice identifies PNAS Fig 5A bottom Raf, Fig 5D middle rh-Endo and Fig 4A top phospho-FAK images (PDF pp6–8). The 2026 correction separately addresses similar blots in Figs 4C/5C and unavailable originals. Its linked preprint tests phospho-Akt/total Akt in HUVEC on fibronectin with 20 micrograms/ml recombinant human fragments; it does not repeat integrin blockade, angiogenesis, apoptosis or ERK assays. The correction therefore does not establish resolution of all 2019 concerns. This is not a retraction or proof that every experiment is false. Independent PMID:10837460 and PMID:12842087 support retained fragment biology. Original PNAS full main text remains unavailable; public notice, correction and preprint links and short anchors are in COL4A3-notes.md and the source-evidence index.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Human tumstatin-integrin binding and signaling; correction/comment notices7/8 also inspected, ROOT handles primary adjudication.

primary_access.title: Extracellular matrix signatures of human primary metastatic colon cancers and their metastases to liver.

reference_review.review_notes: Actual selected original human colon/liver extraction and MS Methods read, plus original supplementary A/B COL4A3 row 115. The group Q01955 with four alternatives has 40 total unique peptides; this is positive group detection, not unique isoform identification or a tensile-force assay. Collagen structural classification uses independent assembly and the current GO collagen comment.

actual_read_entries.scope: Actual complete selected paragraph text read; no uninspected figure-pixel or separate supplement claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Actual human sample and extraction/proteomic Methods plus gene-set analysis. Repeated selected-cache paragraphs are not independent evidence.

primary_access.title: Proteomic characterization of human multiple myeloma bone marrow extracellular matrix.

reference_review.review_notes: Protected normal abstract and original supplementary S2 row 46 and S3 rows 43/43/18/58/86 read. The COL4A3 group includes all five accession variants. S2 MGUS nd is a classification distinct from the two positive MGUS sample observations in S3; no universal absence is inferred. Supports matrix detection, not direct force measurement. No full primary Methods claim.

primary_access.title: Characterization of the Extracellular Matrix of Normal and Diseased Tissues Using Proteomics.

reference_review.review_notes: Selected cache is flagged full but inspected content contains Introduction and results-bearing protocol optimization/Discussion rather than the complete separate Methods and target supplement. The exact COL4A3 supplemental row remains unverified. Its source-specific location/class is retained with independent human target ECM and assembly evidence, not a fabricated table read.

actual_read_entries.scope: Actual complete selected paragraph text read; no uninspected figure-pixel or separate supplement claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Selected original Introduction, results-bearing optimization and Discussion/conclusions; separate complete Methods/supplement target table not recovered.

primary_access.title: Collagen Fibril Assembly and Function.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete available collagen-fibril review abstract read. The exact alpha3/type-IV passage remains unresolved without full text. Independent target assembly supports the existing type-IV-trimer class; collagen-fibril organization remains source-specific undecided. No claim that the paper excludes COL4A3 or that type IV can never affect fibrils. The previous COL4A1 MISCITED judgment is not source evidence. Its current reopened review likewise records this inaccessible source-specific link as UNVERIFIED; no full alpha3 passage has been recovered to justify MISCITED here.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: General fibrillar-collagen review abstract; exact type-IV participation not established in this excerpt.

primary_access.title: Human collagen genes encoding basement membrane alpha 1 (IV) and alpha 2 (IV) chains map to the distal long arm of chromosome 13.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete original abstract read: chromosome mapping of alpha1/alpha2 collagen-IV genes. Its exact relevance to the inherited alpha3 structural assertion is unverified because the full text was not recovered. Independent COL4A3 assembly supports structural refinement; no experimental wrong-gene removal is inferred from the title/abstract.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Alpha1/2 gene mapping abstract; no confident experimental misattribution claim from abstract.

primary_access.title: Identification of mutations in the alpha 3(IV) and alpha 4(IV) collagen genes in autosomal recessive Alport syndrome.

reference_review.review_notes: Publisher PDF: https://www.nature.com/articles/ng0994-77.pdf . Selected Results/Discussion/Methods text and printed page 78, including Figs. 1–2, were inspected in the original review; the saved page was rechecked for this clarification. Human COL4A3 families VB and DU have hearing loss, with a DU audiogram at 13 years and glomerular immunostaining providing clinical context. COL4A4 results are distinct. No direct auditory-transduction assay or inspection of every figure is claimed. The separately retained abstract cache does not describe the extent of external access.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Clinical human COL4A3/4 genotype and Alport phenotype abstract; original inspected separately.

actual_read_entries.scope: Actual original PDF printed78 clinical findings/Fig1–2 pixels plus selected extracted Results/Discussion/Methods windows; not all other figure pixels
actual_read_entries.assessment: Human COL4A3 families VB and DU have hearing loss; DU audiogram at13years. NC1 mutations and clinical GBM defects support contextual hearing role without direct auditory signal assay.

primary_access.title: Localization of type IV collagen a 1 to a 6 chains in basement membrane during mouse molar germ development.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete available original abstract read: mouse molar-germ basement-membrane collagen-IV chain localization. Exact alpha3 panels were not inspected. The current mouse source is preserved alongside independent human basement-membrane evidence, without claiming a new human developmental assay.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Mouse developmental dental basement-membrane localization; no primary alpha3 detail in available abstract.

primary_access.title: Krüppel-like zinc-finger transcription factor KLF5/BTEB2 is a target for angiotensin II signaling and an essential regulator of cardiovascular remodeling.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete available original abstract read: KLF5 cardiovascular remodeling. It does not expose the exact curated Col4a3 complex experiment, and full Methods were not recovered. Preserve the positive current donor record and independent human type-IV assembly support; a title about KLF5 is not grounds for a wrong-gene assertion.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Mouse KLF5 cardiovascular study abstract does not expose exact Col4a3 complex assay; preserve curator and independent target assembly.

primary_access.title: Quaternary organization of the goodpasture autoantigen, the alpha 3(IV) collagen chain. Sequestration of two cryptic autoepitopes by intrapromoter interactions with the alpha4 and alpha5 NC1 domains.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete original abstract read: alpha3/alpha4/alpha5 protomers, NC1 hexamers and autoepitope sequestration support the type-IV assembly class. Bounded full-text recovery was unsuccessful. Original reagent species/constructs are not resolved by this abstract. No full Methods, isolated force assay or equivalent assembly of all five alternative products is claimed.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Alpha3/4/5 protomer and NC1 hexamer association; abstract molecular composition and network scope.

primary_access.title: Laminin-1 reexpression in Alport mouse glomerular basement membranes.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete original mouse abstract read: Col4a3-deficient GBM initially downregulates laminin-1 and later reexpresses it during maturation. Supports the source-scoped structural developmental context, not collagen-catalyzed laminin production. Original full experimental text was not recovered.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Col4a3-deficient mouse GBM maturation and laminin reexpression; structural maintenance context, not laminin synthesis catalysis.

primary_access.title: Physiological levels of tumstatin, a fragment of collagen IV alpha3 chain, are generated by MMP-9 proteolysis and suppress angiogenesis via alphaV beta3 integrin.

reference_review.review_notes: Selected Results and Methods support human recombinant tumstatin rescue in mouse hosts and beta3-dependent endothelial/Matrigel effects. Repair-associated skin/liver angiogenesis was unaffected in the examined comparisons. Bovine GBM digestion by MMP9 is a distinct generation assay, not COL4A3 protease or inhibitor activity. Public full text: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2775452/ ; the source index preserves exact selected-text locators. No separate supplement or figure-pixel reading is claimed here.

actual_read_entries.scope: Actual complete selected paragraph text read; no uninspected figure-pixel or separate supplement claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Actual integrin-null mouse endothelial and Matrigel assays plus recombinant-expression/assay Methods. Source excludes universal angiogenesis effect; bovine GBM digestion is separate.

actual_read_entries.scope: Actual complete selected Results entries read, including headings/captions; no figure pixels
actual_read_entries.assessment: Human recombinant tumstatin rescues mouse tumor vascularity; beta3-dependent response differs from wound/liver repair. Proteolytic generation is not protease inhibition.

primary_access.title: Abnormal basement membrane in the inner ear and the kidney of the Mpv17-/- mouse strain: ultrastructural and immunohistochemical investigations.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete available mouse Mpv17 mutant abstract read. Broad collagen-IV/BM distribution is described; exact alpha3-specific panels were not recovered. Current curated mouse localization and independent human target evidence remain separate.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Mpv17 mutant mouse BM collagen-IV distribution; no unobserved exact chain localization detail added.

primary_access.title: Tumor-specific expression of the RGD-alpha3(IV)NC1 domain suppresses endothelial tube formation and tumor growth in mice.

reference_review.review_notes: Complete available original abstract read: tumor-directed expression of an engineered RGD-containing NC1 construct inhibits endothelial/tube and tumor outcomes. Exact current donor mapping is preserved, but engineered targeting is not assigned to native human collagen or every splice product. Full Methods were not recovered.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Tumor-directed RGD-containing engineered NC1 expression suppresses endothelial proliferation/tubes; do not assume native human all-product assay.

reference_review.review_notes: Protected original abstract read: mouse ECM screening/body-map context. The precise Col4a3 staining panel was not independently recovered. Retained human localization is independently supported, without relabeling this study as a human assay.

actual_read_entries.scope: Complete available selected abstract and stated notices actually read; no full Methods claim
actual_read_entries.assessment: Mouse ECM screening and body-map immunohistochemistry scope; original target panel remains uninspected.

primary_access.title: Findings of Research Misconduct.

reference_review.review_notes: The official Federal Register notice identifies the PNAS2003 article and the three affected-image passages on PDF pp6–8.
